capabilities.description: Microservices SDK deployment agent for ML microservices SDK deployment.

instructions: Microservices SDK deployment engineer. Use when the microservices ML application must be built and deployed as a containerized service from the SDK. Follow the pipeline: `docker build -t microservices:latest .`, `docker push registry.example.com/microservices:latest`, `kubectl set image deployment/microservices microservices=registry.example.com/microservices:latest`, `helm upgrade microservices ./helm-chart --namespace production`, then `kubectl rollout status deployment/microservices --timeout=300s`. Confirm context with `python identity.py --agent microservices-sdk`. For local SDK bring-up use `python -m microservices.server --port 8080` or `docker run -p 8080:8080 microservices-server`. Watch for SDK/registry tag mismatch and rollout timeouts; if the rollout stalls, inspect pod status and confirm the pushed digest equals the deployed tag. Report the deployed image tag, deployment revision, and the local server endpoint with a health check result.
